binding_artifacts.consistency_rule: all twelve registry, resolved-config and implementation locations resolve to the four approved values; missing, duplicate, implicit or divergent bindings block the build

implementation.anchor_cardinality: each semantic anchor occurs exactly once and resolves to the approved binding-map value

binding_coverage_rule: the derivation ledger, resolved configuration and implementation must each resolve all four bindings explicitly; no implicit default path is allowed
build_order: validate authored source, decision, thesis and binding layers
validate and freeze input-only scenarios and independent oracles
run python3 -I -B -X utf8 scripts/verify_manifest.py --root . --manifest manifests/SOURCE_SHA256.txt and require exit code zero
run the reference scenario recipe and unit tests
validate coverage and all generated outputs
execute every validator_registry entry and require zero exit codes
build deterministic ZIP and its external SHA-256 sidecar
failure_policy: any missing predecessor, count mismatch, schema failure, hash mismatch, unresolved ledger target or nonzero command exit stops all downstream nodes

generator_registry.rule: BUILD_RECIPE.json records the lowercase SHA-256 of every generator and validator after materialization, every listed executable is included in manifests/SOURCE_SHA256.txt, and any hash mismatch is refused

planned_commands: python3 -I -B -X utf8 scripts/validate_derivation_ledger.py --ledger sources/DERIVATION_LEDGER.csv --schema schemas/derivation_ledger.schema.json --provenance PROVENANCE.json

pre_run_source_manifest_gate.failure_policy: a missing source member, unexpected member, hash mismatch, malformed record or nonzero exit blocks every reference-run node
pre_run_source_manifest_gate.source_builder_inclusion: scripts/build_source_manifest.py is itself an authored generator included in manifests/SOURCE_SHA256.txt
pre_run_source_manifest_gate.stage: after all authored inputs, generators and validators are frozen and before any reference run or unit test

validator_registry.acceptance_rule: both commands must return exit code zero against the frozen inputs; any missing validator, hash mismatch or nonzero exit blocks BUILD_RECORD, final manifest and archive
validator_registry.source_manifest_membership: every validator path is mandatory in manifests/SOURCE_SHA256.txt
validator_registry.stage: after derived-output validation and before BUILD_RECORD.json and MANIFIESTO_SHA256.txt

validators.validator_command: python3 -I -B -X utf8 scripts/validate_derivation_ledger.py --ledger sources/DERIVATION_LEDGER.csv --schema schemas/derivation_ledger.schema.json --provenance PROVENANCE.json
